rationale:
Issue #826 (labeled bug, closed by PR #873) reports that `--fix-function-typedefs` rewrites `typedef void MyFunction(var parameter);` into `typedef MyFunction = void Function(var dynamic parameter);`, which does not compile. The minimized production patch touches only lib/src/source_visitor.dart in visitSimpleFormalParameter: it moves the unconditional `modifier(node.keyword)` out of the shared path and, inside the `_insideNewTypedefFix && !hasType` branch where `dynamic` is synthesized, suppresses the `var` keyword while still emitting its preceding comments via writePrecedingCommentsAndNewlines. That is exactly the reported defect's mechanism, and it is a pre-existing behavior bug in the existing fix path, not a new feature. The minimized patch excludes the CHANGELOG.md entry, the pubspec.yaml version bump to 1.3.4-dev, and the fixture change present in the original commit, so it contains no documentation, configuration, or test-only content and no unrelated refactor beyond the required relocation of the modifier call. The trigger is the project-native fixture test/fixes/function_typedefs.unit as changed in the same upstream fixing commit, exercised through the existing test/fix_test.dart harness (selector 'fixes function_typedefs.unit'); it adds `>>> issue #826` and `>>> issue #826 with comment` cases matching the issue reproducer verbatim, plus corrections to pre-existing `var v3` expectations in the positional/optional/named metadata cases. It relies on no production API introduced by the fix, only on the pre-existing --fix-function-typedefs flag. Strict machine evidence for both the original and post-minimization states reports all gates passed: build.both_versions, selectors.present_and_unique (1 valid, unique), trigger.buggy_differential reproducing test/fix_test.dart::fixes function_typedefs.unit, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (3 fingerprint groups), matrix.complete (32 runs, 3 repetitions), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, and full_suite.fixed_all_green. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#826 is the sole entry in allowed_root_cause_ids, so this root cause is not a duplicate.

Issue #826 (labeled bug, closed by PR 873) reports that `--fix-function-typedefs` rewrites `typedef void MyFunction(var parameter);` into `typedef MyFunction = void Function(var dynamic parameter);`, which does not compile. The minimized production patch in lib/src/source_visitor.dart addresses exactly that: the unconditional `modifier(node.keyword)` is moved into the non-typedef-fix branch, and in the `_insideNewTypedefFix && !hasType` branch the `var` keyword is suppressed (while its preceding comments are still emitted via writePrecedingCommentsAndNewlines) because `dynamic` is being synthesized in its place. `final` is still emitted, consistent with `final dynamic x` being valid, so the behavior change is narrowly scoped to the reported invalid emission. The minimized patch contains only these two behavioral hunks; the CHANGELOG.md entry and the pubspec.yaml 1.3.3 -> 1.3.4-dev version bump present in the original commit are excluded, and no refactor, formatting, or feature extension is present. The trigger is the project-native fixture test/fixes/function_typedefs.unit driven by the pre-existing test/fix_test.dart harness under the existing test name "fixes function_typedefs.unit"; it is the unmodified upstream test portion of the same fixing commit, adds the literal issue reproducer (`typedef void MyFunction(var parameter);` -> `dynamic parameter`) plus a comment-retention variant, corrects three prior expectations that had baked in the buggy `var dynamic` output, and depends on no production API introduced by the fix (the `--fix-function-typedefs` path and `_insideNewTypedefFix` exist in the buggy revision 302882a). Strict machine evidence passes on both the original and post-minimization runs: build on both versions, unique selector, buggy differential reproducing test/fix_test.dart::fixes function_typedefs.unit, deterministic fingerprints over 3 repetitions across a 32-run matrix, fixed isolated/suite/reversed all clean, and fixed full suite green with buggy full-suite failures limited to the declared trigger. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#826 is in allowed_root_cause_ids, so the root cause is not a duplicate.
